description: This source file implements functions related to an HTTP Protocol Service Object (HttpPsoVer2), handling client query processing, receiving data from client, finishing sessions, accepting client connections, and authenticating sessions. It is part of a larger HTTP server framework, specifically for the Http Pso Ver2 Object. The code includes standard licensing and copyright headers, and defines several key methods used in managing HTTP transaction records and client interactions.

methods.name: ULONG HttpPsoVer2QueryForClient(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Queries the processing mode for the current client interaction, determines whether to process, collect, or forward data based on the transaction record's response.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpPsoVer2RecvFromClient(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Handles data received from the client, forwarding it to the current transaction record for processing and managing session state accordingly.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpPsoVer2FinishedByClient(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Marks the session as finished when the client connection is closed, cleans up transaction record and buffer resources.

methods.name: BOOL HttpPsoVer2AcceptClient(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Determines whether to accept an incoming client connection based on WAM interface logic.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpPsoVer2Authenticate(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Performs session authentication; in this implementation, it always succeeds.
